column1: # REBUILD-TARGETS.tsv: the run record and the sha256 values of each project file of TOM 1.0.0.
# The files went through the release write: the organization columns and the pseudonyms of the
# identity columns, in one write, with a salt. The salt is deleted by design. Then the root build,
# the re-encode and the release passes of TOM (steps/release-passes/) changed them. So no one can
# make the published bytes again. The rebuild has these targets:
#   merge_input_sha256    the file that the run gave (merge_input = run), or the file after the
#                         trailer post-fix of the run output (merge_input = post-fix);
#   pre_pseudonym_sha256  the file after the merge (the metadata columns of the final sidecar,
#                         the merge encoding): the input of the release write;
#   source_root_sha256    the file of the source root of the release passes (after the release
#                         write and the re-encode; ctp schema 2, 71 columns);
#   published_sha256      the file of TOM (ctp schema 3, 53 columns; data/SHA256SUMS). It is equal
#                         to the pre_pseudonym file in every column that the release write and the
#   project, layer        the name of MANIFEST.tsv; the build of the project: v1 = 5,000 or more
#                         commits, x1k = 1,000 to 4,999 (rebuild-one takes the merge sidecar of it).
#   run_record            proven: a run ledger record whose Parquet sha256 starts the sha256 chain
#                         to the published file; rows-only: the record has the rows of the file,
#                         but no sha256 chain (the files of the path-fix rerun).
#   run_commit            the commit that the run checked out (the ledger pinned_sha / checked_out_sha).
#                         The runs used --latest: this is not column 6 of the S7 manifests.
#   frame_commit          the snapshot commit of the frame (column 6 of the S7 manifests).
#   cregit_commit, ctp_commit   the tool commits of the run (tools.lock).
#   merge_input           run, post-fix or unknown (see above).
#   run_sidecar           the project_meta sidecar file of the run (the ledger flag --project-meta).
#   run_meta_entry_sha256 the sha256 of the entry of the project in that file (JSON with sorted
#                         keys, no spaces, UTF-8). ctp reads only this entry. rebuild-one takes a
#                         sidecar under pipeline/s7-run with an equal entry. Empty: no unique copy
#                         of the run sidecar was found.
# Sources: the run ledgers of the dataset build, the merge reports, the report of the release
# write, the BRL-CAD kit and the SHA256SUMS of the roots. Made on 2026-10-28 for the source root
# (10,754 rows). On 2026-11-07 the rows became the 8,449 project files of TOM: source_root_sha256
# is the old published_sha256, and published_sha256 is the row of the final SHA256SUMS of TOM
# (b7141d088461...). The run_commit of each row is equal to run_commit of MANIFEST.tsv of TOM.
# On 2026-11-09 published_sha256 became the row of the SHA256SUMS of the revision of TOM 1.0.0
# (ea2052f7ce8b..., steps/release-passes/pass-5-revision/): the value pass of the license column gave
# 3,528 of the 8,449 files new bytes. The 149 new projects of the revision (steps/new-projects/) have
# no row here: rebuild-one says "not ready" for them.
